description.narrative: The India National Agricultural Innovation Project contributes to the sustainable transformation of Indian agricultural sector to more of a market orientation to relieve poverty and improve income. The specific aim is to accelerate collaboration among public research organizations, farmers, the private sector and stakeholders in using agricultural innovations. The project has four components. Component 1 strengthens the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) as the catalyzing agent for managing change in the Indian National Agricultural Research System (NARS) by focusing on: 1.1 Information, communication and dissemination system; 1.2 Business planning and development; 1.3 Learning and capacity building; 1.4 Policy and gender analysis and visioning; 1.5 Remodeling financial management and procurement systems; and 1.6 Project implementation. Component 2 funds research on production-to-consumption systems. Component 3 funds research on sustainable rural livelihood security. Component 4 supports basic and strategic research in the frontier areas of agricultural science.

The overall objective is to contribute to the sustainable transformation of Indian agricultural sector from an orientation of primarily food self-sufficiency to one in which a market orientation is equally important for poverty alleviation and income generation.The specific objective is to accelerate the collaborative development and application of agricultural innovations between public research organizations, farmers, private sector and other stakeholders.

condition.narrative: ICAR shall establish by March 31 2009, a complete list of CPs, eligible to carry out subprojects
ICAR shall implement the Project in accordance with the PIP and ESMF
Within 180 days of effectiveness ICAR shall employ a suitable NC for part A of the project
Within 180 days of effectiveness, ICAR shall ensure that the Project's Financial Management Software is operational and availableon line
Within 90 days of effectiveness ICAR shall employ for the duration of the Project internal Auditors whose TOR, qualifications andexperience are acceptable to the Association
Within 90 days of effectiveness ICAR shall put in place support mechanisms for consortia formation and operation
the ND of the PIU shall be assisted by a Director of Finance, a procurement officer and for each component a national coordinator
